text:
Maya: ok urgent question — who else has a pet that treats laundry like a trampoline? posted a pic below 😂 https://i.imgur.com/abcd1234.jpg
Sam: haha Sable strikes again. that exact face says "i'm helping" 😍
Jordyn: adopt more towels? 😂 also stolen socks count as taxes at this point
Eli: legendary. I once found a sneaker in the cat bed. submitted for evidence 🧾
Tess: Sable is single-pawedly solving our sock surplus problem 🧦 👍
Maya: quick poll — is this a 'let the cat be' situation or 'put laundry away immediately' situation?
Sam: 1) let cat be 2) put away immediately 3) take more photos for blackmail
Jordyn: 3, always 3
Eli: 1 if it's napping, 2 if it's eating a sock
Tess: 3 then 1. blackmail keeps morale high
Maya: vote tally: 1 x2, 2 x1, 3 x3 (very scientific) 📈
ops-bot: reminder — office plants are still not allowed to be used as cat jungle gyms. recorded incident 34.
Sam: LOL ops-bot is watching us
Jordyn: ok new idea — weekend photo drop? everyone post a pet pic on #random this Friday at 2pm PT, prize = most dramatic nap
Eli: I'll bring the completely unbiased judging criteria (stick figure doodles)
Maya: done. will bribe Sable with tuna to perform a dramatic nap act 🐟
Tess: please capture the sock theft in slo-mo if possible
Sam: if anyone needs socks, message me. i will start an anonymous lost-sock support group
Maya: thanks team. i'm putting the laundry away... cautiously. 👀
